text:
Priya K: Found an unlabelled cookie jar on the kitchen counter. WHOSE IS THIS? :detective:
Liam: Not mine. I only bring suspiciously named hummus. :sweat_smile:
Sam M: guilty! left some from baking last night — help yourself :) Also adding a sticky note now. :chef:
Olivia: Wait is anything gluten-free or should I start a solemn vigil outside the kitchen? :eyes:
Priya K: Quick poll — react with :chocolate_bar: for chocolate chip, :maple_leaf: for oatmeal. Also please write your name on the jar or put `claim: <name>` on a Post-it so we don't start a cookie cold war.
DevBot: Friendly kitchen reminder: please label homemade items and log perishable contributions in #kitchen-log. Next automated reminder in 3 days.
Sam M: Added a Post-it and will refill on Friday. Chocolate chip > oatmeal.
Liam: Friday bake-off?? Count me in. :raised_hands:
Olivia: I'll bring coffee if someone brings something gluten-free. :coffee:
